name: Defold
description:
Defold is a completely free, developer-friendly 2D and 3D game engine designed for cross-platform publishing. It features a lightweight, high-performance C++ runtime driven by Lua scripting, making it ideal for indie developers and game jams.

Features:
- Turnkey game development environment with scene editor, particle effects, and tilemaps
- Fast Lua scripting with integrated code completion and debugging tools
- Exceptionally small build output and ultra-fast compilation times
- Comprehensive 2D physics powered by Box2D and 3D physics via Bullet
- Cross-platform export targeting Linux, Windows, macOS, Android, iOS, and HTML5
